title: Help more people find SMA education
description: Support outreach that brings parents, caregivers and communities to the free Understanding SMA course.
included: Paid outreach to introduce the free SMA course to people in Nigeria. Video delivery and platform running costs are separate.
costNote: Planning allowance: US$1 per targeted enrolment × 10,000 enrolments = US$10,000. This is the foundation’s budgeting assumption, not a measured acquisition cost or a guarantee of enrolments or completions. The budget can be adjusted as actual campaign results become available.

title: Deliver free SMA video lessons
description: Help cover the streaming cost of the free SMA course, including an allowance for learners watching the videos again.
included: 300,000 minutes of video delivery. The 15-minute course allowance is rounded for budgeting.
costNote: Planning calculation: 15 minutes × two full viewings × 10,000 learners = 300,000 delivered minutes. At Cloudflare Stream’s published US$1 per 1,000 delivered minutes, delivery is US$300, or US$0.03 per learner. Actual charges depend on minutes delivered, including buffering. Video storage, hosting, database, emails, learner support and maintenance are separate; existing shared infrastructure is contributed to the programme.

title: A complete clinician consultation
description: Help cover assessment, advice about testing, review of available results and an explanation for the family.
included: The foundation’s agreed end-to-end consultation scope.
costNote: Current programme fee. Clinicians can donate their service; testing and hospital procedures are separate.

title: Confirmatory SMA genetic testing
description: Help a family access the genetic test recommended after a clinical assessment.
costNote: A complete written quotation is being obtained, including collection, sample transport, testing and explanation of results. No fixed test price is published yet.

title: Patient hoist with sling
description: Help provide a patient hoist for transfers, with fitting and use guided by the person’s care team.
included: Hoist and the sling shown in the supplier photograph.
costNote: Supplier-indicated equipment price. Delivery, fitting, training and running costs are not confirmed.

title: Oxygen concentrator
description: Help provide a concentrator where it is prescribed as part of an individual respiratory care plan.
costNote: Supplier-indicated price; model, flow rate, power requirements and delivery remain to be confirmed. This is not a ventilator.

title: Pulse oximeter
description: Help provide an oximeter selected by the care team, with the appropriate sensor and guidance for its use.
costNote: Supplier-indicated price. Brand, sensor size, accuracy specifications and suitability are not confirmed.

title: Double-bottle suction machine
description: Help provide a double-bottle suction machine where the care team recommends it.
included: Double-bottle machine pictured; accessories and power backup require confirmation.
costNote: Supplier-indicated equipment price. Delivery, fitting, training and running costs are not confirmed.

title: Single-bottle suction machine
description: Help provide the compact single-bottle suction machine shown by the supplier.
included: Single-bottle machine pictured. Battery operation has not been confirmed.
costNote: Supplier-indicated equipment price. Delivery, fitting, training and running costs are not confirmed.

title: Single-crank hospital bed
description: Help provide an adjustable hospital-style bed for an assessed home-care need.
included: Bed pictured. Mattress is costed separately.
costNote: Supplier-indicated equipment price. Delivery, fitting, training and running costs are not confirmed.

title: Double-crank hospital bed
description: Help provide a hospital-style bed with two manual adjustment cranks.
included: Bed pictured. Mattress is costed separately.
costNote: Supplier-indicated equipment price. Delivery, fitting, training and running costs are not confirmed.

title: Bed mattress
description: Help provide a mattress matched to the bed and the person’s assessed needs.
costNote: Supplier-indicated price. Dimensions, material, cover and delivery require confirmation.

title: Air mattress overlay
description: Help provide an air mattress overlay where recommended for the person’s care.
included: Supplier image shows an overlay and pump; pump inclusion in the price still needs confirmation.
costNote: Supplier-indicated equipment price. Delivery, fitting, training and running costs are not confirmed.

title: Hand and foot splints
description: Help cover professionally assessed and fitted splints.
costNote: Prices are being obtained. Assessment, fitting and replacement as a child grows must be included.

title: Prescribed medical nutrition
description: Help provide the feed prescribed for an individual child, together with nutritional follow-up.
costNote: Cost depends on the prescribed product, daily volume and supply route. Products may include Nutrini Multi Fibre or a prescribed peptide-based feed; one product is not assumed suitable for every child.

title: Feeding supplies and follow-up
description: Help cover compatible giving sets, syringes, extensions and dietetic follow-up.
costNote: The care team’s feeding plan determines supplies and replacement frequency. Prices are being obtained.

title: Feeding assessment and tube placement
description: Help a family access swallowing assessment and a feeding-tube procedure when recommended by their clinical team.
costNote: Hospital quotations must cover assessment, procedure, anaesthesia, any admission, aftercare and supplies. Tube placement is an individual clinical decision.

title: Appointments and rehabilitation
description: Help with transport to care, rehabilitation appointments and practical caregiver training.
costNote: Support is based on assessed need, local provider costs and available funding. A costed plan is agreed before support is arranged.
